name: Adzviser YouTube
description:
Connect your YouTube channel analytics data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files — Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about views, watch time, and subscriber growth. Compare videos and channels, dig into likes, comments, and audience retention, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking yesterday's results or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser YouTube to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser YouTube to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://youtube.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser YouTube MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser YouTube provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_youtube, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser YouTube?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser YouTube in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser YouTube MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser YouTube requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser YouTube is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
